description: List the saved revisions of one recipe the user can see: who changed it, what and when (newest first, up to 100). Read-only. Use it to find a revision_no before restore_revision. Returns {id, title, revisions:[{revision_no, changed_by, change_summary, created_at (ISO 8601)}]}.

id.description: Recipe id (UUID) from search_recipes or an earlier result

name: list_history
title: Recipe history
